commits.author: d.okafor
commits.subject: refactor(auth): centralise origin resolution behind resolveOrigin()
commits.body: Pulls the public origin out of four call sites. Callback URL now derives from resolveOrigin() so self-hosted deployments stop hardcoding app.meridian.io.

commits.author: s.lindqvist
commits.subject: chore(auth): extend session ttl to 12h after churn review
commits.body: Product asked for fewer forced re-logins on the Team plan.

commits.author: d.okafor
commits.subject: feat(auth): add single-use password reset tokens
commits.body: Reset tokens are hashed at rest and consumed on first successful use. TTL is one hour.

commits.author: m.reyes
commits.subject: feat(api): retry retryable upstream statuses in the report worker
commits.body: Transient 5xx from the events upstream was failing whole report runs. Retries up to 8 attempts.

commits.author: s.lindqvist
commits.subject: feat(billing): handle charge.refunded webhooks
commits.body: Adds a reversal path to the ledger. charge.succeeded handling is unchanged.

commits.author: m.reyes
commits.subject: chore(exports): publish the 50MB ceiling in the rejection message
commits.body: Support asked for the limit to appear in the error text so customers stop filing tickets for it.
